description: Replace exact, unique text snippets in up to 5 existing text files. Use when you know the exact text to change. Do not use it for every match of a pattern; use `replace_text` instead. To apply a unified diff, use `patch`; for a new file or a whole rewrite, use `create`. Each file is all or nothing: an unmatched or ambiguous oldText writes nothing to that file, and other files still run; dryRun reports unmatched text instead of failing. Missing, binary, non-UTF-8, and over-size-cap (default 10 MiB) files fail. Returns one summary line per file (+added -removed, NO MATCH, or FAILED); a dry run appends unified diffs. With undo enabled, live runs add an undo id for `undo`, valid 30 minutes.

dryRun.description: Write nothing; return a unified diff per file. An unmatched oldText is reported instead of failing; an ambiguous one still fails

edits.description: Replacements for path, applied in order; each oldText is matched against the text the earlier edits left. Required with path

newText.description: Replacement text. Use an empty string to delete the matched oldText.

oldText.description: Exact text to find. It must match exactly once, so include 3-5 lines of context. Several matches fail and list up to 5 line numbers.

files.description: Batch mode: one entry per file, each with its own edits
